_about: The 3D match view (Stage 5, docs/STAGE_5_MATCH_DAY.md). Read by src/render/match. Distances in metres, speeds in metres per second, angles in degrees. Stadium space: x along the pitch (0 is the centre spot), z across it (+z is the main stand, where the broadcast camera sits), y up.

camera._about: The broadcast camera sits on a gantry just in front of the main stand (its front wall is at z 40) and pans to follow the ball. hfov is the horizontal field of view it keeps on any screen shape (the vertical one is clamped to minVfov-maxVfov). follow is the share of the ball's x the camera body moves; the aim follows the ball fully, out to maxX. lookZ is the share of the ball's z the aim takes. damping is how quickly it catches up (higher is snappier).

players._about: Gaits blend by ground speed. clips are each gait's own speed in the animation; the legs are sped up or slowed to match the ground, within timeScale. Below standAt a player stands; he faces his run when faster than faceRunAt, otherwise the ball. turnRate is how quickly he turns (per second).

kit._about: Kits are painted onto the bare base body by region, measured on the model's rest pose (a T-pose, about 1.8 m tall). y is height, ax the distance out along the arms.

looks._about: Each player's skin tone, hair colour and hair, seeded from his id. Styles list the hair pieces worn together; an empty list is a shaved head.

shadow._about: Soft round shadows under the players and the ball (cheaper than real shadows for 23 moving things).
